apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: vuoro-shared
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  path: clusters/main/kubernetes/apps/vuoro-shared/app
  prune: true
  wait: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: cluster
  # The database Kustomization checks migration Job completion. For schema
  # cutovers, suspend both Kustomizations and stop every old runtime pod before
  # resuming the database; explicitly observe the new Job Complete and schema
  # handshake before resuming this runtime. Dependency readiness alone does
  # not establish that an old writer has stopped. See the main-branch runbook
  # docs/runbooks/sprintctl-work-schema-v25-cutover.md.
  dependsOn:
    - name: vuoro-shared-db
  healthChecks:
    - apiVersion: apps/v1
      kind: Deployment
      name: vuoro-shared
      namespace: vuoro-shared
